condition.name: RW-sonnet-low
condition.description: ResearchWorld：E2E 任务用全部岗位（HuTian v4.9 起 8 个，v4.8.2 及更早 9 个）；所有岗位同一模型（Sonnet low，更弱的 worker 的第二档）
condition.description_en: ResearchWorld: all roles for E2E tasks (8 since HuTian v4.9, 9 on v4.8.2 and earlier); the same model in every role (Sonnet low, the second rung of the weaker workers)
condition.notes: 阶段二“worker 由弱到强”（#357，维护者 2026-11-14）：全部岗位一起换成更弱的 worker，从头跑 e2e-formal 的 10 道；和 RW-sonnet 只差 thinking level，对应单 agent 阶梯的 CC-sonnet-low。开跑等评测器验收（#395）和选定的 ResearchWorld 版本。
condition.notes_en: Phase 2, workers from weak to strong (#357, maintainer 2026-11-14): every role swapped to a weaker worker together, run from scratch on the 10 tasks of e2e-formal; it differs from RW-sonnet only in the thinking level and matches CC-sonnet-low of the single-agent ladder. Runs start after the evaluator's acceptance (#395) and the choice of the ResearchWorld version.

meaning.zh: ResearchWorld：E2E 任务用全部岗位（HuTian v4.9 起 8 个，v4.8.2 及更早 9 个）；所有岗位同一模型（Sonnet low，更弱的 worker 的第二档）；provider —，推理强度 low。
meaning.en: ResearchWorld: all roles for E2E tasks (8 since HuTian v4.9, 9 on v4.8.2 and earlier); the same model in every role (Sonnet low, the second rung of the weaker workers); provider —, reasoning effort low.

system.name: researchworld
system.description: HuTian ResearchWorld 4.10.0, this project's own install (images :rwe-v4.10.0)

agent.name: Claude Code
agent.how: one agent per role through acpx's ACP adapter in the role's sandbox container

network.search: the shared search tool (MCP server rwe-search in every sandbox) through the same shield
network.web_access: every request of every role through the run's shield proxy, HuTian's mandatory upstream proxy with the shield's CA: the same URL, keyword, id and date rules as the other systems, the shield logs each URL; no direct way out, server-side search and remote tools off (Issue #73)

tools.permissions: acpx --approve-all --non-interactive-permissions fail: every tool call the agent asks for is approved; the role's sandbox container is the boundary

preinstalled.zh: HuTian 的 system image researchworld:rwe-v4.10.0 和 worker image researchworld-worker:rwe-v4.10.0（acpx 与各 agent 的 ACP 适配、researchworld 包的 Python、Node.js）
preinstalled.en: HuTian's system image researchworld:rwe-v4.10.0 and worker image researchworld-worker:rwe-v4.10.0 (acpx and each agent's ACP adapter, Python with the researchworld packages, Node.js)

reasons.resources.cpus: world.json sets no resources: each role's sandbox gets HuTian's defaults
reasons.limits.time_limit_hours: the world configuration sets no budget.total_seconds: `run --hours` or the run's settings file sets it
